SELECT List.*, DC.DeptBase, DC.DeptKo, DC.DeptEn, DC.DeptJa, DC.DeptFr, DC.DeptZhcn, DC.DeptZhtw, DC.DeptManyName, DC.TitleBase, DC.TitleKo, DC.TitleEn, DC.TitleJa, DC.TitleFr, DC.TitleZhcn, DC.TitleZhtw, DC.TitleManyName, DC.DutyBase, DC.DutyKo, DC.DutyEn, DC.DutyJa, DC.DutyFr, DC.DutyZhcn, DC.DutyZhtw, DC.DutyManyName FROM DP_TAS_ListTO List WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN DP_COM_DeptCode AS DC WITH(NOLOCK) ON List.CompanyID = DC.CompanyID AND List.DeptCodeID = DC.DeptCodeID WHERE List.CompanyID = '{0}' AND List.ListID = '{1}'

SELECT List.*, DC.DeptBase, DC.DeptKo, DC.DeptEn, DC.DeptJa, DC.DeptFr, DC.DeptZhcn, DC.DeptZhtw, DC.DeptManyName, DC.TitleBase, DC.TitleKo, DC.TitleEn, DC.TitleJa, DC.TitleFr, DC.TitleZhcn, DC.TitleZhtw, DC.TitleManyName, DC.DutyBase, DC.DutyKo, DC.DutyEn, DC.DutyJa, DC.DutyFr, DC.DutyZhcn, DC.DutyZhtw, DC.DutyManyName FROM DP_TAS_ListCC List WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT OUTER JOIN DP_COM_DeptCode AS DC WITH(NOLOCK) ON List.CompanyID = DC.CompanyID AND List.DeptCodeID = DC.DeptCodeID WHERE List.CompanyID = '{0}' AND List.ListID = '{1}'

SELECT Distinct * FROM ( SELECT CompanyID, UserID FROM VW_UserInfo WHERE CompanyID = '{0}' AND ActiveUser = 1 AND DeptID in ( SELECT s.DeptID FROM DP_TAS_ListCC AS c CROSS APPLY dbo.ufn_GetSubTree(c.DeptID, c.CompanyID) s WHERE c.CompanyID = '{0}' AND c.ListID = '{1}' AND c.IsGroup='G') Union SELECT CompanyID, UserID FROM DP_TAS_ListCC WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CompanyID = '{0}' AND ListID = '{1}' AND IsGroup='M' Union SELECT CompanyID, UserID FROM DP_TAS_ListTO WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CompanyID = '{0}' AND ListID = '{1}' ) x LEFT JOIN DP_ACC_UserEnv UE ON x.CompanyID = UE.CompanyID AND x.UserID = UE.UserID

SELECT Count(*) as RECnt, (SELECT Count(*) FROM DP_TAS_ListTo WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CompanyID = '{0}' AND ListID = '{1}' AND UserID = '{2}') as TOCnt, (SELECT Count(*) FROM DP_TAS_ListCC WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CompanyID = '{0}' AND ListID = '{1}' AND ((UserID = '{2}' AND IsGroup = 'M') OR (DeptID IN (SELECT DeptID FROM ufn_GetUserUpTree ('{0}' ,'{2}')) AND IsGroup = 'G' ))) as CCCnt FROM DP_TAS_List WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE CompanyID = '{0}' AND ListID = '{1}' AND WriteUserID = '{2}'
